exact_statement: For integers L >= 2, m >= 1 let f = prod_{b=1}^m AND_L(x_b) on disjoint blocks (+-1 valued). For every order pi of the mL coordinates, R_pi(f) >= 2^(1-L) sum_{p=1}^{mL} max{0, ln p - ln((L+1)/2 + (p-1) 2^(1-L))}; I(f) = mL 2^(1-L); H(f)/I(f) = H(AND_L)/I(AND_L) < 4; and liminf_{m -> infinity} min_pi R_pi(f)/I(f) >= (L-1) ln 2. Hence the right side of B19-RANKCODE-REDUCTION is at least (2(L-1) - o(1)) I(f) for every order while H(f) < 4 I(f): no single-order rank code proves FEI with a constant uniform over all Boolean functions.

proof_source: Per coordinate c at position p: ln(p/N_p) >= 0 with N_p = |S intersect pi^{-1}[1,p]|; Jensen gives E[1{c in S} ln(p/N_p)] >= P(c in S) max{0, ln p - ln E[N_p | c in S]}; P(c in S) = 2^(1-L); given c in S its block's other members are in S independently with prob 1/2 and other blocks are independent, so E[N_p | c in S] <= (L+1)/2 + (p-1) 2^(1-L). H(AND_L)/I(AND_L) <= 4 - [4 + 2(L-1)eps - 2(1-eps)/ln2]/L < 4 with eps = 2^(1-L). The liminf follows from the increasing integrand phi(t) = ln t - ln(c - q + q t). Checks: exhaustive over all orders for (m,L) = (2,2),(3,2),(2,3); certified rows L=4..32 (e.g. L=8, mL=1e9: rank term >= 13.99997 I vs H <= 3.8428 I).

exact_statement: For each L>=2 let t=4^L, r=4L+1, p=2^-r, h_L=1-2 A_L on L fresh fair bits, g=z0 product_{j=1}^t h_L on disjoint data blocks with fresh balancing sign z0, N=tL+1, and F=1+A_r(g-1) on fresh point controls. The one-support uniform-nonempty A008 dictionary R_g(T)=1/(2^N-1), transferred by vacuum mass (1-p)^2, control-only mass p^2, and data mass p^2 R_g(T), is a fixed normalized full-output reference. Its nonempty reference divided by v=p(2-p) has normalization and both sector/control projection debts zero; the entire remaining debt is C-H(F)=p[log2(2^N-1)-t H(h_L)]. Its I(F)=p[2L2^L+4L+2] tends to zero, minority probability is p/2, C/I(F)>=2^(L-2), and H(F)<4I(F). Hence (C-H(F))/I(F)>2^(L-2)-4 tends to infinity. The failure is for the specified uniform dictionary, not FEI, general dictionaries or the original incidence queue. Independently, for a product of m width-L point-defect signs, every coordinate order has R=d ln((mL)!)-E ln(K!), d=2^(1-L), I=mLd, a=(L+1)/2-Ld, and ln(1/d)-ln(1+a/I)-(1+ln(I+1))/I <= R/I <= ln(1/d)+(1+ln(mL+1))/(mL); thus its exact all-order limit as m grows is (L-1)ln2.
